pair_construction.method: chosen=min absolute PkaHead error; rejected=max absolute PkaHead error
filters: Remove exact held-out task, ordered source/target-molecule, or source-molecule overlap before pair construction.
Canonicalize and deduplicate valid generated candidates within each training row.
Require at least two unique valid candidates.
Require rejected absolute error - chosen absolute error > margin.
No direction-correctness filter is applied to chosen.
